project.title: Premium Desk Lamp Product Story
project.goal: Create a 50-second ecommerce product video showing a premium adjustable desk lamp improving a focused evening work session.
project.visual_style: realistic cinematic product footage, premium but practical

main_subject.role: young professional working at a desk
main_subject.appearance: late 20s, calm focused expression, short dark hair, neutral skin tone
main_subject.wardrobe: charcoal knit sweater, no visible logos
main_subject.movement_style: small realistic movements, focused and deliberate

product.name: matte black adjustable LED desk lamp
product.shape: slim vertical stem, circular weighted base, horizontal light bar
product.materials: matte black metal with subtle satin finish
product.required_visibility: lamp must be clearly visible in every scene

location.setting: modern apartment home office at night
location.background: wood desk, laptop, notebook, pen, soft shelves in background
location.lighting: warm lamp light as primary source, cool dim city light outside window

camera_language.lens: natural product-focused closeups and medium shots
camera_language.movement: slow push-ins, gentle slides, controlled handheld-free motion

scenes.purpose: Establish the workspace and product presence before the lamp turns on.
scenes.start_state: A dim modern home office at night with the matte black desk lamp visible but off beside a laptop and notebook.
scenes.end_state: The user's hand reaches toward the lamp control while the lamp remains the central product in frame.
scenes.camera_movement: Slow push-in from a medium desk view toward the lamp.
scenes.subject_motion: The professional enters frame partially and reaches toward the lamp.
scenes.environment_motion: Subtle city light flicker outside the window, otherwise still.
continuity_references: matte black adjustable LED desk lamp
modern apartment home office at night
wood desk with laptop and notebook
